| 来源与责任 | 实际记录 |
|---|---|
| 提出者 | <actual person or role; unknown stays unknown> |
| 原始来源 | <faithful quotation/source, facts vs feedback vs assumptions> |
| 接受责任人 | <Owner or evidenced delegated responsibility> |
| 原意核对记录 | <link one decision original, or explicitly not yet confirmed; real time/responsibility/scope> |

| 当前内容与适用基线 | <current revision and complete accepted version/snapshot; an edited Issue URL or hash alone is insufficient> |
| 主跟踪 Issue | <actual Issue/PR or not yet in backlog; progress stays there> |

## 1．问题与现状

<What problem does the proposer encounter? Preserve sourced wording and current facts separately.>

## 2．期望结果

<Desired outcome in the proposer's terms; stable item labels support downstream coverage.>

## 3．成功判断

<Observable success, known measures and unresolved thresholds/time/population. Unknown remains unknown.>

## 4．范围与约束

<Accepted vs uncovered scope, constraints, dependencies and source roles. Link engineering coverage/PLAN rather than copying progress. Preserve old acceptance after substantive revision, log source/reason/old baseline/affected engineering documents.>

## 5．未决项

<Question, responsible decision maker, dependency, status and source. Pause only dependent work. Distinguish original-meaning confirmation, acceptance, state and operation authorization.>
